title: Merge PR and return to base branch
description:
## Implementation
1. `gh pr merge --repo juansita/devmeta --merge` — never --squash or --rebase.
2. Check out the base branch and pull.

## Tests
Run: `cd slides && npm run build` on the base branch after merging.
acceptance_criteria: PR merged with --merge; base branch builds green
closed_reason: PR #2 merged with --merge; on base branch; build and diagrams green
